check_diagonally_dominant: check if a square matrix is diagonally dominant by comparing diagonal elements to row sums
test_f_gold: test the f_gold function with a matrix and row count to verify diagonal dominance
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to use Python builtins like sum instead of manual accumulation loops
summarize_f_gold: summarize the f_gold function which checks diagonal dominance of an n by n matrix
run_diagonal_check: run the f_gold function on a 2D list matrix to return True or False for diagonal dominance
